agricultural: Agricultural land displays large, regularly gridded patches of uniform crop rows with distinct linear textures, distinguishing it from the long wide strips of smooth uniform gray pavement of runways, the large expanses of manicured bright green turf with scattered bunkers of golf courses, and the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors.
airplane: An airplane appears as a compact, bright metallic cross-shaped object with sharply defined wings and fuselage, distinguishing it from the elongated linear pavement of runways, the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white lines of parking lots.
baseballdiamond: A baseball diamond features a distinctive fan-shaped green outfield with a diamond-shaped dirt infield and a circular arc boundary, distinguishing it from the small precisely rectangular surfaces with crisp white lines of tennis courts, the large expanses of manicured turf with scattered bunkers of golf courses, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular parking grids of parking lots.
beach: A beach presents a broad, smooth expanse of fine-grained light tan sand with a gentle natural transition to water, distinguishing it from the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers, the dense rough uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation of chaparral, and the large expanses of manicured bright green turf of golf courses.
buildings: Buildings appear as clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops, varied shadow patterns, and heterogeneous materials, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white parking lines of parking lots, and the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks.
chaparral: Chaparral exhibits a dense, rough, and uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation with irregular brownish-green tones, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of agricultural fields, the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beaches, and the widely scattered individual houses with abundant vegetation of sparse residential areas.
denseresidential: Dense residential areas show tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing, narrow streets, and very limited green space, distinguishing them from the moderately spaced houses with visible yards and regular street grids of medium residential areas, the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks, and the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings.
forest: A forest exhibits a dense, continuous dark green canopy with a fine-grained rough clumpy texture showing no geometric structure, distinguishing it from the large expanses of manicured bright green turf with scattered bunkers of golf courses, the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, and the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers.
freeway: A freeway appears as a long, wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings and consistent linear geometry, distinguishing it from the clear crossing pattern of two or more paved roads of intersections, the very long wide straight strip of smooth uniform gray pavement of runways, and the elevated linear concrete structure crossing perpendicularly over another road of overpasses.
golfcourse: A golf course features large expanses of manicured bright green turf with scattered sand bunkers, winding cart paths, and irregularly shaped greens, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of agricultural fields, the dense rough uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation of chaparral, and the dense continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forests.
harbor: A harbor contains complex water boundaries with linear dock structures, moored ships appearing as large bright elongated objects, and cranes, distinguishing it from the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white parking lines of parking lots, the clusters of perfectly circular uniform-sized bright metallic cylindrical structures of storage tanks, and the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks.
intersection: An intersection displays a clear crossing pattern of two or more paved roads with visible lane markings and traffic infrastructure at the junction, distinguishing it from the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, and the elevated linear concrete structure crossing perpendicularly over another road of overpasses.
mediumresidential: Medium residential areas feature moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards, a regular street grid, and a balanced mix of rooftops and green space, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks, and the widely scattered individual houses with large gaps between structures of sparse residential areas.
mobilehomepark: A mobile home park consists of many small, uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows with minimal green space, distinguishing it from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings, and the moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards of medium residential areas.
overpass: An overpass appears as an elevated linear concrete structure crossing perpendicularly over another road or feature, casting distinct shadows on the surface below, distinguishing it from the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, the clear crossing pattern of two or more paved roads of intersections, and the very long wide straight strip of smooth uniform gray pavement of runways.
parkinglot: A parking lot presents a large flat gray paved surface with a regular grid of thin white parking space lines and scattered small dark vehicle rectangles, distinguishing it from the clusters of perfectly circular uniform-sized bright metallic cylindrical structures of storage tanks, the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks, and the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings.
river: A river appears as a sinuous, naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water with irregular banks and variable width, distinguishing it from the dense continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forests, the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beaches, and the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of agricultural fields.
runway: A runway is a very long, wide, straight strip of smooth uniform gray pavement with centralized markings and surrounded by flat open tarmac, distinguishing it from the compact bright metallic cross-shaped object of airplanes, the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, and the clear crossing pattern of two or more paved roads of intersections.
sparseresidential: Sparse residential areas show widely scattered individual houses with abundant surrounding vegetation and large gaps between structures, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings, and the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks.
storagetanks: Storage tanks appear as a cluster of perfectly circular, uniform-sized bright metallic or white cylindrical structures with consistent shadows, distinguishing them from the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white parking lines of parking lots, the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors, and the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of agricultural fields.
tenniscourt: A tennis court is a small, precisely rectangular surface with crisp white boundary lines, a central net line, and a uniform colored interior often surrounded by fencing, distinguishing it from the distinctive fan-shaped green outfield with diamond-shaped dirt infield of baseball diamonds, the clusters of rectangular structures with sharp rooftops of buildings, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white parking lines of parking lots.
